_readme: Optional external models. Map a model key to a .glb in this folder, e.g. "abrams": "abrams.glb" or "abrams": { "file": "abrams.glb", "length": 4.7, "rotY": 90 }. Keys: abrams, battlemaster, overlord, technical, scoutcar, comanche, drone, a10, plus any other unit model key in js/sim/factionRegistry.js. With no entries, every unit uses its procedural model.
